threads.rootCause: a type-check or build-tool gate is scoped, dry-run-interpreted, or artifact-cached such that it structurally cannot observe a real class of failure (tsconfig include/exclude gaps, turbo --dry=json counting a NONEXISTENT task as success, package suites reading a stale dist/ build as fresh, a story's own tsconfig excluding shipped browser entries)

a test or gate reports pass without exercising the real behavior or path it claims to verify — a phase guard never reached by a real-path test, a resume path the harness structurally cannot enter, or a seed/determinism trapdoor one layer above where a prior fix closed it
a single fact is kept in one canonical source but re-derived or hand-duplicated through a separate mechanism elsewhere instead of being imported, so the copies drift silently
a comment or example file describes a mechanism, behavior, or grammar that has since been removed or changed, and nothing sweeps for surviving references when the removal lands
